1238-5621-8323-8324.easyPrerequisites: You're able to play a land this turn.
1238-5621-8323-8324.description:
Play Arid Archway
When Arid Archway enters, it and Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger, causing you to create a Jace planeswalker token and put two loyalty counters on it.
Activate the Jace token by removing a loyalty counter from it.
Way of the Paradox triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and allowing you to play another land this turn.
Resolve the Jace token's ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Activate Heart of Kiran's crew ability by removing a loyalty counter from the Jace token.
The Jace token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having no loyalty.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability.
Repeat.

1436-5089-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
1436-5089-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-5089-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2558-3490-4659-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

277-4094-4365-4772-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-4094-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2626-3661-4986-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

364-864-1987.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
364-864-1987.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
364-864-1987.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

3197-3330-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-3330-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4823-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-1251-2034-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

341-1805-4331-4993.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

4268-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
4268-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

4050-5010-5113-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2173-4905-5220-6094.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3634-3821-5542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
3634-3821-5542.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1339-2122-4050-5042.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Insects, adding {2}.
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability twice by paying {2} and discarding two cards, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2510-2866-3689-6518.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-2866-3689-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

252-2981-5394.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

804-5686-5756.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

1116-1385-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-1385-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

1170-3542-6059.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{R}{R}
1170-3542-6059.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}{R}
Cast Ghitu Firebreathing by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Ghitu Firebreathing spell.
Activate Ghitu Firebreathing by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

224-423-2309-3143-5411.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one land.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Fall of the Thran has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
224-423-2309-3143-5411.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Fall of the Thran triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Fall of the Thran's second or third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land, giving a creature haste until end of turn.
You may optionally repeat step 3 one additional time.
If Fall of the Thran has three loyalty counters on it, activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a lore counter from Fall of the Thran, causing you to populate.
Resolve the Fall of the Thran chapter trigger from step 2, causing each player to return two land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Whenever the land(s) enter the battlefield, Evolution Sage and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger for each land that entered the battlefield under your control.
Holding priority, if the land(s) enter the battlefield untapped, you may activate them by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, if applicable, either causing you to scry 1 or to tap or untap target creature.
Resolve the first Evolution Sage trigger, putting a lore counter on Fall of the Thran.
Repeat from step 2.
If applicable, resolve all remaining Evolution Sage triggers, causing you to proliferate that many times.
If you sacrifice and return two lands each cycle, this combo will net infinite untap of creatures you control and infinite scry 1.

522-1236-3466.description:
Cast Rattleblaze Scarecrow by paying {6}.
Rattleblaze Scarecrow enters the battlefield, triggering Reaper King, destroying Rattleblaze Scarecrow.
Rattleblaze Scarecrow dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Melira.
Repeat from step 3.

666-3542.notablePrerequisites:
An Island exiled by Extraplanar Lens.
You control at least six Islands.
666-3542.description:
Cast Palinchron for {5}{U}{U}.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping at least six Islands you control.
Activate six Islands you control by tapping them, adding twelve {U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning Palinchron to your hand.
Repeat.

813-2103-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Scholar of the Ages.
813-2103-4305.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Scholar of the Ages.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Repeat.
